//: Development keys, for a development profile. Until the `tools` mod of 04 §3.5 exists they live here, behind the preference `development`, which no screen offers and a profile sets: `profiles/dev.json` does. Elsewhere F12 does nothing.
name: Development keys
doc: Whether the development keys work. Set by a development profile; no screen offers it.

//: The omniscient view (12 §3.2, §5): the play screen's map drawn from what is really there, not from what the character has seen. The application acts on the preference named `omniscient` wherever a mod defines it, never keeps it between runs, and empties the character's map memory whenever it changes, so that nothing learnt from truth is left behind.
name: See everything
doc: Draw the world as it really is, whatever the character could see. For development.

//: F12 in play. Outside a development profile it leaves the view as it is.
name: See everything
doc: Switch between what the character sees and what is really there, in a development profile.
